text:
maya: Pinging runtime folks — scheduling a mixed k6/locust soak Tue 03:00 UTC. Multi-region, ~2h, target ~12k QPS total. Primary asks: profiling (flamegraphs), canary smoke gates, and replay orchestration. Who can own which piece?

jonathan: I can own flamegraph capture + upload. Which profiler do we want to standardize on for this run? async-profiler or perf-based sampling?

sasha: async-profiler (cpu) is fine for the C++ runtime paths; 99% sampling flag works. I’ll prep a sudoer entry for the infra hosts so we can attach. Also check `kernel.perf_event_paranoid` before starting.

luis: I’ll take canary + smoke gates. Proposal: initial canary ramp to 500rps per region, validate 95p latency and error rate, then proceed to full soak.

rekha: I’ll own the replay mix (k6 for synthetic burst patterns + locust for user-like sessions). I’ll upload the replay artifacts. Where should I drop them?

maya: use s3://redwood-inference/soaks/1963344550/ — put `configs/`, `flames/`, and `logs/` subfolders. Also capture kv-cache metric snapshots (`kv_cache_hit`) at 5m intervals.

jonathan: plan for profiler: run async-profiler for 60s samples during steady-state windows: `sudo ./async-profiler/profiler.sh -d 60 -e cpu -f /tmp/fg-epoch1.html <pid>` then gzip and upload. I’ll name uploads `flames/epoch-<region>-t{timestamp}.html.gz`.

luis: k6 snippet for canary (example):
```
k6 run --vus 250 --duration 15m --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086/k6_canary \ 
  --summary-export=canary-summary.json script.js
```
Adjust VUs per region to hit ~500 rps for the ramp phase.

sasha: Preflight steps I’ll run tonight: check `kernel.perf_event_paranoid`, ensure `perf` package installed, confirm `ulimit` for open files, and patch sudoers for `async-profiler`. I’ll post the preflight script in the s3 `configs/` path.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: soak-job queued for Tue 03:00 UTC (job id: soak-1963344550). Coordinator: rekha. Canary window at 03:05 UTC.

replay-bot: replay scheduled: locust master (us-east1), workers in eu-west1 & us-west1. Logs: /var/log/soak/1963344550, streaming to s3://redwood-inference/soaks/1963344550/logs/

maya: Quick checklist + owners: jonathan = profiling & upload, rekha = replay orchestration, luis = canary/smoke dashboards & abort thresholds, sasha = node preflight. cc @eng-oncall for on-call awareness. Abort criteria: 95p latency > 250ms or token error rate > 1% during canary.

jonathan: ack. I’ll upload a pre-run smoke flamegraph after the dry-run tonight.

luis: I’ll create a temporary dashboard and wire an alert: if 95p > 250ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> trigger abort and notify #incidents.

rekha: uploaded configs: s3://redwood-inference/soaks/1963344550/configs/mix-1963344550.json (k6+locust mix).

maya: thanks — dry-run tonight 23:00 UTC. If you can’t make the dry-run DM me. Otherwise we’ll proceed with full run Tue 03:00 UTC. Post results/links in this thread. :thumbsup:
